summary: Phase 12 — DB-stored credentials store + ThriveDesk → Nifty escalation loop + Slack notifier. Backend: 14/14 phase12 tests + 30/30 phase 10+11 regression all PASS (44/44 total). Frontend: all 8 health pills render on Dashboard (incl. thrivedesk + slack), Integrations credentials form renders 3 providers with test/save buttons, Support Triage page renders with stats, filters, simulate dialog, mock log dialog, and resolve dialog. Both /api/admin/integrations/approval-studio/test and /thrivedesk/test return HTTP 200 with mode=mock (not 503) per spec; /slack/test returns 503 when no webhook URL set.
critical_code_review_comments: Classification engine: URGENT_KEYWORDS + URGENT_TAGS + FEATURE_REQUEST_TAGS evaluated in correct priority (urgent before feature). Verified subject keyword 'blocked' triggers urgent via /webhooks/thrivedesk.
Credentials store correctly masks values (first 4 + bullet ellipsis + last 4) and empty-string PUT clears stored field — both verified by tests.

Reverse-sync (relay_nifty_completion_to_thrivedesk) wired into milestone_routes.nifty_webhook — flow path verified by code inspection but not exercised E2E because no live Nifty token is set; covered separately by simulate+resolve which mocks the ThriveDesk reply.
Slack notifier graceful no-op: /slack/test returns 503 when webhook_url empty — confirmed by test. Health endpoint records ping after credentials saved without restart.
Simulate dialog pre-fills 'URGENT: Checkout is failing on mobile' subject + 'High Priority' tag — good UX for QA / demos.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every spec'd selector and flow renders

seed_data_creation: Tests created ephemeral TEST_ escalations in support_escalations collection via simulate-ticket. Mock-mode entries persist but are harmless and used by future regression runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 12 is fully shipped and verified. ThriveDesk + Approval Studio + Slack all run in MOCK mode (no creds set in DB credentials store or .env). The new /admin/integrations Credentials section lets the user paste keys for any of the 3 providers without redeploy — saved Slack webhook URL immediately reflects in the health endpoint (next ping). Set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest. To exercise reverse-sync E2E, set a live Nifty token + add a task with custom field ThriveDesk_Ticket_ID then mark Complete via Nifty webhook.
